run.note: Enemies spawn non-stop and ramp up until bossAtSec, then the Frog King arrives. Surges are short bursts that feel like waves. The wave counter goes up by one at every surge.

openingRush.note: A ring of grubs burrows out of the ground near the seed right at the start, so a Stinger-only run is lost in seconds.

spells.note: slots = spells you can carry in a run. chancePerCard = how often a pack card is a spell instead of a helper. Each star: effects last starPower times longer and the spell recharges starHaste times as fast.

nectar.note: Nectar drops from kills and buys Meadow Packs in the middle of a run. The price grows with every pack bought that run. Sealed packs (from the Hatchery and Big Clutch) open for free. While you flip a card the fight keeps going at revealTimeScale speed. hatcherySec[i] = seconds between free packs at Hatchery level i+1.

pity.note: After this many packs in a row with nothing Epic or better, the next card is Epic or better.

mastery.note: Mastery earned per run = perKill x kills + perSec x seconds survived + miniBoss each + boss for the Frog King, times Harvest.

firstRun.note: Your very first run is a forced, quick loss that opens the Market and skill tree. The seed starts this weak only on run 1.

chapters.note: Each Frog King you beat moves you to the next chapter. Inside an act, each chapter adds hpPerChapter enemy health (boss too) and spawnPerChapter spawn rate. After perAct chapters the next menu starts the next Act: the skill tree and Mastery reset and you keep Heartwood (1 per heartwoodPer Mastery you had invested). Each Heartwood gives +heartwoodMastery Mastery from runs, forever. acts[i]: hpMult = enemy health, armor = extra armor on every enemy, speedMult = enemy speed, mechanic = the line shown at the start of a run.

acts.name: Act II
acts.mechanic: Blight-hardened shells: every enemy shrugs off 20% more physical damage

acts.name: Act III
acts.mechanic: Blight-hardened shells, and the swarm moves 20% faster
